name: Belianes (Spain)
description: Purple field with two yellow bends from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: The official flag of Belianes is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, purple, with two yellow bends of thickness 1/6 of the height of the cloth; approved on 31 March 1994 and published in the DOGC on 20 April 1994.

features.role: two bends of 1/6 of the height from the upper hoist to the lower fly
